semantic.justification: Original associated-character stage of MoveProperties: shallow fixed Western/CJK/CTL traversal, associated versus normal keywords, CJK langfe exception, exact native posture/weight/height reduction, independent bidi/script flags, one-shot run-state reset and StyleDefinition state preservation. The outer writer collects its borrowed effective character items into a temporary native set and releases it after emission. Full MSWord run script/bidi production, complete general-formatting buffers, font identity/charset-to-current-encoding effects, paragraph-marker properties and RTF language/associated-format import remain unverified or unported. The existing font-table callback identifies names; no fake encoding or bidi provider is introduced.
